guards.what: G1 (DORMANT): C#'s fourth clause is `if (dealer != Owner.Creature && cardSource.Owner != Owner) return 0;` -- an AND of two negatives, i.e. fire when EITHER holds; the sim requires `dealer is self.player` alone (fake_strike_dummy.py:31)
guards.issue: MECHANISM: FakeStrikeDummy.cs:35-38 declines only when the dealer is not the owner's creature AND the card does not belong to the owner. In single-player the card's owner is always the player, so the second half is always false and the clause NEVER declines -- C# adds the +1 to any powered attack from a Strike-tagged player card regardless of who the dealer is, including a null dealer. The sim's single `dealer is self.player` test declines whenever the dealer is anything else. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b05.py strike-dummy): the same 6-damage Strike with dealer=None lands for 6 in the sim where C# gives 7. REACHABILITY (DORMANT, and the census is executed rather than asserted): the probe lists the 8 ported cards carrying CardTag.Strike (ashen_strike, perfected_strike, pommel_strike, seeker_strike, setup_strike, strike, twin_strike, ultimate_strike) and then AST-scans all 119 DamageCmd.deal call sites under sts2_rl/ for any that passes a card but no dealer -- 13 sites, every one of them a self-damage/HP-loss effect on a non-Strike card (bad_luck, beckon, blood_wall, bloodletting, burn, decay, hemokinesis, infection, offering, regret, toxic, wither) plus enchantments.py:500, whose props are UNBLOCKABLE|UNPOWERED|MOVE and therefore never reach the additive chain at all. So no ported path today deals a Strike-tagged card's POWERED damage with a dealer other than the player. Porting a player-side minion or ally that swings a player card, or any effect that deals a Strike card's damage with dealer=None, makes it live -- and the divergence is in the silent direction: the sim simply fails to add the 1. Rule 7: enchantments.py and the 12 card modules are unhashed here.
